title: Guest List Change Velocity
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:rsvp action=guest_list_update
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as changes by _time
| sort - _time
description: Shows how rapidly the guest list is changing as the event approaches.
value: High change velocity late in planning creates budget, seating, and communications churn.
implementation: Tag guest-list update events in `event:rsvp` and summarize weekly change volume.
visualization: Line chart of guest-list changes by week.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how fast the guest list is still changing as the big day gets closer.
